summary: re-point T087, T088 and T102 to T105 and T106 and repair the A0013 identity finding on T102
owner_direction: Owner direction: execute the A0014-recorded lower-layer follow-through for the two read surfaces that cite the manifest by its predecessor and for the robustness consumer, and close the A0013 finding on T102 in the same amendment. T087: replace the normative T063 reference with T105 as the range and coverage authority and require registry and schema bound coverage provenance; keep T069 as the product-run dependency and confirm its amended closure carries T105 rather than adding a duplicate edge; no current page path may parse the predecessor manifest as current; legacy manifests stay read-only and labelled historical and their registry fields are never inferred; failed, cancelled, missing or mismatched current runs show fail-closed evidence states and cannot publish selectable coverage; verification covers a positive T105-backed range display, negative legacy, unregistered, schema or revision mismatch and failed or cancelled cases, a migration fixture preserving old checksums, and an old-path-unreachable assertion for the predecessor reader. T088: replace T063 with T105 as the checksum and provenance authority the same way, preserve every result-display obligation, reconcile result, coverage and attribution checksums solely against the validated T105 manifest linked by the T069 run, keep historical results and manifests byte-identical and visibly legacy, render no complete-looking result for a failed, cancelled or incomplete run, and verify a positive T105 checksum trace plus negative tamper, revision, legacy, failed and cancelled cases with compatibility and migration fixtures and old-path-unreachable coverage. T102: add T106 as a direct dependency and replace T064 with T106 as the current robustness and anti-overfitting protocol, so walk-forward evaluation consumes the registered schema, declared ranges and revision and cannot call the unrestricted predecessor builder as current; combine this with the repair the A0013 finding on this task requires, namely that a model-backed strategy obtains a registered identity and is requested by that registered identity instead of being assumed to fit the replaceable interfaces; missing, legacy-only or mismatched T106 evidence yields an uncertain or no-trade outcome or blocks publication rather than falling back; model and robustness evidence grants no execution authority and cannot weaken or bypass T070; verification covers positive evaluation over heterogeneous registered schemas plus negative undeclared, out-of-range, wrong-unit, wrong-revision, legacy-path and fail-closed cases and old-path-unreachable proof. Preserve every still-valid obligation, acceptance criterion and Must-not clause of all three contracts; change only these three contracts and their dependency fields; do not touch any other task, document or revision; and resolve exactly the open impacts this amendment genuinely closes, leaving every other impact open and naming it.
